basic_info.description: Welcome home to this rare jewel box, located in sophisticated Presidio Heights. This thoughtfully designed home is space-efficient with elegant finishes and features a modern kitchen with a pantry. Escape from the hustle and bustle of city living in the whimsical backyard, adorned with a luscious lemon tree, aromatic rosemary, and fragrant flowers. This pied-a-terre is steps away from exclusive boutiques, award-winning interior design firms, and world-class dining restaurants such as Spruce, Sociale, and Magic Flute.  This well-managed HOA has remarkably low monthly dues of just $285! Last but not least, enjoy the convenience of a free laundry room. This gem is luxury living at an incredible value!
